	private static final String COMMIT = "a7b7cedd1c954dc55fa8265f7e6fc4d215fdb1aa";
	private static final String LMDB_JAR_SHA = "99e31060a43c662ec8022ebf7087f3be2609a1cbea39d5582e0160f20d45b3db";
	private static final ValueFactory VF = SimpleValueFactory.getInstance();
	private static final String NS = "http://example.org/";
	private static final String PREFIX = "PREFIX : <" + NS + ">\n";
	private static final String LONG_LABEL = "a label that is far too long for a short LMDB key ".repeat(3);

	private static final Literal ABC_EN = VF.createLiteral("abc", "en");
	private static final Literal ABC_UPPER = VF.createLiteral("abc", "EN");
	private static final Literal ABC_MIXED = VF.createLiteral("abc", "En");
	private static final Literal XYZ_UPPER = VF.createLiteral("xyz", "EN-GB");
	private static final Literal XYZ_LOWER = VF.createLiteral("xyz", "en-gb");
	private static final Literal LONG_EN = VF.createLiteral(LONG_LABEL, "en");
	private static final Literal LONG_UPPER = VF.createLiteral(LONG_LABEL, "EN");
	private static final Literal RTL_UPPER = VF.createLiteral("abc", "AR", Literal.BaseDirection.RTL);
	private static final Literal RTL_LOWER = VF.createLiteral("abc", "ar", Literal.BaseDirection.RTL);
	// a triple term over a losing literal with no counterpart keeps its id and has its object rewritten
	private static final Literal Q_LOWER = VF.createLiteral("q", "en");
	private static final Literal Q_UPPER = VF.createLiteral("q", "EN");
	// the triple term over the losing literal is stored first, so it survives (rewritten) and the other one loses
	private static final Literal W_LOWER = VF.createLiteral("w", "en");
	private static final Literal W_UPPER = VF.createLiteral("w", "EN");


	private record Op(boolean explicit, Statement statement) {
	}

	private LmdbLanguageVariantFixtureProducer() {
	}

	public static void main(String[] arguments) throws Exception {
		if (arguments.length != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected one new owned output root");
		}
		Path jar = Path.of(LmdbStore.class.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation().toURI());
		require(Files.isRegularFile(jar) && LMDB_JAR_SHA.equals(sha256(Files.readAllBytes(jar))),
				"LmdbStore must originate from the exact immutable pinned JAR");
		Path root = Path.of(arguments[0]).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
		require(!Files.exists(root), "Generation root must be absent");
		Files.createDirectories(root.getParent());
		Files.createDirectory(root);
		Path directory = Files.createDirectory(root.resolve("store"));
		writeInitialDescriptor(directory);
		Properties metadata = new Properties();
		metadata.setProperty("fixture.schema", "1");
		metadata.setProperty("producer.commit", COMMIT);
		metadata.setProperty("producer.lmdb.jar", jar.getFileName().toString());
		metadata.setProperty("producer.lmdb.jar.sha256", LMDB_JAR_SHA);
		try (InputStream code = LmdbLanguageVariantFixtureProducer.class
				.getResourceAsStream("LmdbLanguageVariantFixtureProducer.class")) {
			require(code != null, "Compiled generator class must be available");
			metadata.setProperty("producer.helper.class.sha256", sha256(code.readAllBytes()));
		}
		metadata.setProperty("platform.os.arch", System.getProperty("os.arch"));
		metadata.setProperty("platform.byte.order", ByteOrder.nativeOrder().toString());
		metadata.setProperty("platform.pointer.bytes", Integer.toString(Pointer.POINTER_SIZE));
		metadata.setProperty("platform.java.feature", Integer.toString(Runtime.version().feature()));
		List<List<Op>> sessions = sessions();
		metadata.setProperty("sessions", Integer.toString(sessions.size()));
		for (int session = 0; session < sessions.size(); session++) {
			List<Op> operations = sessions.get(session);
			metadata.setProperty("session." + session + ".operations", Integer.toString(operations.size()));
			for (int operation = 0; operation < operations.size(); operation++) {
				Op op = operations.get(operation);
				metadata.setProperty("session." + session + ".operation." + operation,
						(op.explicit() ? "E|" : "I|") + render(op.statement()));
			}
			LmdbStore store = new LmdbStore(directory.toFile(), config());
			try {
				store.init();
				add(store, operations);
			} finally {
				store.shutDown();
			}
			assertDescriptor(directory);
		}
		Map<String, Long> ids = new LinkedHashMap<>();
		LmdbStore reader = new LmdbStore(directory.toFile(), config());
		try {
			reader.init();
			ValueStore values = (ValueStore) reader.getValueFactory();
			List<Value> expected = captureValues();
			metadata.setProperty("capture.count", Integer.toString(expected.size()));
			for (int index = 0; index < expected.size(); index++) {
				Value value = expected.get(index);
				String spelling = NTriplesUtil.toNTriplesString(value);
				values.clearCaches();
				long id = values.getId(value);
				require(id != -1L, "Every original capture must exist in the actual old dictionary");
				String decoded = NTriplesUtil.toNTriplesString(values.getValue(id));
				require(spelling.equals(decoded), "Cold old ID must decode to the exact original spelling");
				ids.put(spelling, id);
				metadata.setProperty("capture." + index + ".spelling", spelling);
				metadata.setProperty("capture." + index + ".decoded", decoded);
				metadata.setProperty("capture." + index + ".id", Long.toString(id));
			}
			assertOriginalDistinctIds(ids);
			try (RepositoryConnection connection = new SailRepository(reader).getConnection()) {
				for (boolean inferred : new boolean[] { false, true }) {
					List<String> rows = new ArrayList<>();
					try (RepositoryResult<Statement> statements = connection.getStatements(null, null, null,
							inferred)) {
						for (Statement statement : statements) {
							rows.add(render(statement));
						}
					}
					Collections.sort(rows);
					String prefix = inferred ? "old.rows.both." : "old.rows.explicit.";
					metadata.setProperty(prefix + "count", Integer.toString(rows.size()));
					for (int index = 0; index < rows.size(); index++) {
						metadata.setProperty(prefix + index, rows.get(index));
					}
				}
			}
		} finally {
			reader.shutDown();
		}
		assertDescriptor(directory);
		for (String file : List.of("namespaces.dat", "store.properties", "triples/data.mdb", "values/data.mdb")) {
			metadata.setProperty("file." + file + ".sha256", sha256(Files.readAllBytes(directory.resolve(file))));
		}
		inspectClosedNativeStore(directory, metadata);
		for (String file : List.of("namespaces.dat", "store.properties", "triples/data.mdb", "values/data.mdb")) {
			require(metadata.getProperty("file." + file + ".sha256")
					.equals(sha256(Files.readAllBytes(directory.resolve(file)))), "Native capture must be read-only");
		}
		metadata.setProperty("generation.complete", "true");
		try (var output = Files.newOutputStream(root.resolve("fixture.properties"))) {
			metadata.store(output, "Actual immutable a7 writer, three cold sessions, observed IDs and native facts");
		}
		System.out.println("VARIANT_FIXTURE_GENERATED sessions=" + sessions.size() + " captures=" + ids.size());
	}

	private static LmdbStoreConfig config() {
		// Same physical statement/term indexes and default inline/cache policy as the original fixture.
		// Current-only Frontier budget configuration is not an API of this pinned writer.
		return new LmdbStoreConfig("spoc,posc").setTripleTermIndexes("spoc,cspo");
	}

	private static void writeInitialDescriptor(Path directory) throws IOException {
		Properties properties = new Properties();
		properties.setProperty("version", "2");
		properties.setProperty("triple-indexes", "spoc,posc");
		properties.setProperty("triple-term-indexes", "spoc,cspo");
		properties.setProperty("language-tag-key", "byte-exact");
		try (var output = Files.newOutputStream(directory.resolve("store.properties"))) {
			properties.store(output, "Explicit historical byte-exact fixture descriptor");
		}
	}

	private static void assertDescriptor(Path directory) throws IOException {
		Properties properties = new Properties();
		try (var input = Files.newInputStream(directory.resolve("store.properties"))) {
			properties.load(input);
		}
		require("2".equals(properties.getProperty("version")), "Actual descriptor must remain version2");
		require("spoc,posc".equals(properties.getProperty("triple-indexes")), "Actual statement index descriptor");
		require("spoc,cspo".equals(properties.getProperty("triple-term-indexes")), "Actual term index descriptor");
		require("byte-exact".equals(properties.getProperty("language-tag-key")), "Actual byte-exact descriptor");
		require(!Files.exists(directory.resolve("lmdbrdf.ver")), "Pinned version2 must have no format6 fence");
	}

	private static void assertOriginalDistinctIds(Map<String, Long> ids) {
		List<List<Value>> groups = List.of(List.of(ABC_EN, ABC_UPPER, ABC_MIXED), List.of(XYZ_UPPER, XYZ_LOWER),
				List.of(LONG_EN, LONG_UPPER), List.of(RTL_UPPER, RTL_LOWER),
				List.of(tripleTerm(ABC_EN), tripleTerm(ABC_UPPER)), List.of(nested(ABC_EN), nested(ABC_UPPER)));
		for (List<Value> group : groups) {
			long first = ids.get(NTriplesUtil.toNTriplesString(group.get(0)));
			for (int index = 1; index < group.size(); index++) {
				require(first != ids.get(NTriplesUtil.toNTriplesString(group.get(index))),
						"Original fixture requires distinct cold native IDs");
			}
		}
		require(ids.get(NTriplesUtil.toNTriplesString(tripleTerm(W_UPPER)))
				< ids.get(NTriplesUtil.toNTriplesString(tripleTerm(W_LOWER))), "Original W term insertion order");
	}

	private static void inspectClosedNativeStore(Path directory, Properties metadata) throws Exception {
		for (String plane : List.of("triples", "values")) {
			long environment = 0L;
			long transaction = 0L;
			try (MemoryStack stack = MemoryStack.stackPush()) {
				PointerBuffer handle = stack.mallocPointer(1);
				check(mdb_env_create(handle));
				environment = handle.get(0);
				check(mdb_env_set_maxdbs(environment, 64));
				check(mdb_env_open(environment, directory.resolve(plane).toString(), MDB_RDONLY | MDB_NOTLS, 0));
				check(mdb_txn_begin(environment, 0L, MDB_RDONLY, handle));
				transaction = handle.get(0);
				metadata.setProperty("native." + plane + ".txnid", Long.toString(mdb_txn_id(transaction)));
				if (plane.equals("triples")) {
					for (String database : List.of("spocspoc", "poscposc", "spocspoc-inf", "poscposc-inf")) {
						int dbi = database(stack, transaction, database);
						MDBStat stat = MDBStat.calloc(stack);
						check(mdb_stat(transaction, dbi, stat));
						metadata.setProperty("physical." + database, Long.toString(stat.ms_entries()));
						metadata.setProperty("native.triples.page.bytes", Integer.toString(stat.ms_psize()));
					}
				} else {
					int main = database(stack, transaction, null);
					int terms = database(stack, transaction, "term-cspoterm-cspo");
					MDBStat stat = MDBStat.calloc(stack);
					check(mdb_stat(transaction, main, stat));
					metadata.setProperty("native.values.page.bytes", Integer.toString(stat.ms_psize()));
					for (int index = 0; index < captureValues().size(); index++) {
						long id = Long.parseLong(metadata.getProperty("capture." + index + ".id"));
						boolean triple = captureValues().get(index).isTripleTerm();
						byte[] key;
						byte[] value;
						if (triple) {
							long cursor = 0L;
							try {
								check(mdb_cursor_open(transaction, terms, handle));
								cursor = handle.get(0);
								MDBVal nativeKey = MDBVal.calloc(stack).mv_data(stack.bytes(unsigned(id)));
								MDBVal nativeValue = MDBVal.calloc(stack);
								check(mdb_cursor_get(cursor, nativeKey, nativeValue, MDB_SET_RANGE));
								key = copy(nativeKey.mv_data());
								ByteBuffer tuple = ByteBuffer.wrap(key);
								require(Varint.readUnsigned(tuple) == id, "Term native owner must have captured ID");
								for (int component = 0; component < 3; component++) {
									Varint.readUnsigned(tuple);
								}
								require(!tuple.hasRemaining(), "Exact cspo term owner tuple");
								value = copy(nativeValue.mv_data());
							} finally {
								if (cursor != 0L) {
									mdb_cursor_close(cursor);
								}
							}
						} else {
							byte[] encoded = unsigned(id);
							key = new byte[encoded.length + 1];
							key[0] = 5;
							System.arraycopy(encoded, 0, key, 1, encoded.length);
							MDBVal nativeKey = MDBVal.calloc(stack).mv_data(stack.bytes(key));
							MDBVal nativeValue = MDBVal.calloc(stack);
							check(mdb_get(transaction, main, nativeKey, nativeValue));
							value = copy(nativeValue.mv_data());
						}
						String prefix = "capture." + index + ".";
						metadata.setProperty(prefix + "database", triple ? "term-cspoterm-cspo" : "main");
						metadata.setProperty(prefix + "key.hex", HexFormat.of().formatHex(key));
						metadata.setProperty(prefix + "key.sha256", sha256(key));
						metadata.setProperty(prefix + "value.sha256", sha256(value));
					}
				}
			} finally {
				if (transaction != 0L) {
					mdb_txn_abort(transaction);
				}
				if (environment != 0L) {
					mdb_env_close(environment);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static int database(MemoryStack stack, long transaction, String name) throws IOException {
		var result = stack.mallocInt(1);
		check(mdb_dbi_open(transaction, name, 0, result));
		return result.get(0);
	}

	private static byte[] unsigned(long id) {
		ByteBuffer bytes = ByteBuffer.allocate(9);
		Varint.writeUnsigned(bytes, id);
		byte[] result = new byte[bytes.position()];
		bytes.flip();
		bytes.get(result);
		return result;
	}

	private static byte[] copy(ByteBuffer buffer) {
		byte[] result = new byte[buffer.remaining()];
		buffer.get(result);
		return result;
	}

	private static String render(Statement statement) {
		return NTriplesUtil.toNTriplesString(statement.getSubject()) + " "
				+ NTriplesUtil.toNTriplesString(statement.getPredicate()) + " "
				+ NTriplesUtil.toNTriplesString(statement.getObject())
				+ (statement.getContext() == null ? "" : " " + NTriplesUtil.toNTriplesString(statement.getContext()));
	}

	private static String sha256(byte[] bytes) throws Exception {
		return HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes));
	}

	private static void require(boolean condition, String message) {
		if (!condition) {
			throw new AssertionError(message);
		}
	}

	private static void check(int result) throws IOException {
		if (result != MDB_SUCCESS) {
			throw new IOException("Native fixture read result=" + result);
		}
	}

	private static List<Value> captureValues() {
		return List.of(ABC_EN, ABC_UPPER, ABC_MIXED, XYZ_UPPER, XYZ_LOWER, LONG_EN, LONG_UPPER,
						RTL_UPPER, RTL_LOWER, tripleTerm(ABC_EN), tripleTerm(ABC_UPPER), tripleTerm(ABC_MIXED),
						nested(ABC_EN), nested(ABC_UPPER), Q_LOWER, Q_UPPER, tripleTerm(Q_UPPER), W_LOWER, W_UPPER,
						tripleTerm(W_UPPER), tripleTerm(W_LOWER));
	}

	private static List<List<Op>> sessions() {
		List<Op> first = List.of(
				explicit(st("s1", "label", ABC_EN)),
				explicit(st("s1", "label", ABC_EN, "g1")),
				explicit(st("s2", "label", XYZ_UPPER, "g1")),
				explicit(st("s3", "note", LONG_EN)),
				explicit(st("s4", "quote", tripleTerm(ABC_EN))),
				explicit(st("s5", "cites", nested(ABC_EN), "g1")),
				explicit(st("s10", "label", ABC_EN)),
				inferred(st("s6", "label", ABC_EN)),
				explicit(st("s11", "dir", RTL_UPPER)),
				explicit(st("s12", "other", VF.createLiteral("plain"))),
				explicit(st("s20", "label", Q_LOWER)),
				explicit(st("s22", "label", W_LOWER)));
		List<Op> second = List.of(
				explicit(st("s1", "label", ABC_UPPER)),
				explicit(st("s7", "label", ABC_UPPER, "g1")),
				explicit(st("s2", "label", XYZ_LOWER)),
				explicit(st("s3", "note", LONG_UPPER, "g2")),
				explicit(st("s4", "quote", tripleTerm(ABC_UPPER))),
				explicit(st("s8", "quote", tripleTerm(ABC_UPPER), "g2")),
				explicit(st("s5", "cites", nested(ABC_UPPER), "g1")),
				inferred(st("s6", "label", ABC_UPPER)),
				inferred(st("s10", "label", ABC_UPPER)),
				inferred(st("s9", "label", ABC_UPPER, "g2")),
				explicit(st("s11", "dir", RTL_LOWER)),
				explicit(st("s13", "label", ABC_EN)),
				explicit(st("s21", "quote", tripleTerm(Q_UPPER))),
				explicit(st("s23", "quote", tripleTerm(W_UPPER))));
		List<Op> third = List.of(
				explicit(st("s1", "label", ABC_MIXED, "g2")),
				explicit(st("s14", "quote", tripleTerm(ABC_MIXED))),
				explicit(st("s2", "label", XYZ_LOWER, "g1")),
				inferred(st("s15", "label", ABC_MIXED)),
				explicit(st("s24", "quote", tripleTerm(W_LOWER))));
		return List.of(first, second, third);
	}

	private static void add(Sail sail, List<Op> ops) {
		try (NotifyingSailConnection connection = (NotifyingSailConnection) sail.getConnection()) {
			connection.begin();
			InferencerConnection inferencer = (InferencerConnection) connection;
			for (Op op : ops) {
				Statement st = op.statement();
				Resource[] contexts = st.getContext() == null ? new Resource[0] : new Resource[] { st.getContext() };
				if (op.explicit()) {
					connection.addStatement(st.getSubject(), st.getPredicate(), st.getObject(), contexts);
				} else {
					inferencer.addInferredStatement(st.getSubject(), st.getPredicate(), st.getObject(), contexts);
				}
			}
			connection.commit();
		}
	}

	private static Op explicit(Statement statement) {
		return new Op(true, statement);
	}

	private static Op inferred(Statement statement) {
		return new Op(false, statement);
	}

	private static IRI iri(String local) {
		return VF.createIRI(NS + local);
	}

	private static Value tripleTerm(Value object) {
		return VF.createTripleTerm(iri("a"), iri("says"), object);
	}

	private static Value nested(Value object) {
		return VF.createTripleTerm(iri("b"), iri("cites"), tripleTerm(object));
	}

	private static Statement st(String subject, String predicate, Value object) {
		return VF.createStatement(iri(subject), iri(predicate), object);
	}

	private static Statement st(String subject, String predicate, Value object, String context) {
		return VF.createStatement(iri(subject), iri(predicate), object, iri(context));
	}
}
